title: Brain Intracranial Hemorrhage AI Segmentation
description: An end-to-end AI medical platform designed to help clinicians automatically detect brain hemorrhages from CT scans, developed as part of a high-impact research submission for IEEE TMI.
feature:
Engineered a custom SE(2) Equivariant architecture to maximize detection precision.
Parallelized massive deep learning workloads across multiple GPUs to bypass hardware limitations.
Developed a resilient, auto-resuming data pipeline capable of surviving unpredictable cloud server failures.
Designed a custom learning algorithm to tackle highly imbalanced medical datasets.
Bridged the gap between clinical usability and complex AI models by designing a real-time tensor conversion backend.
cv description: Boosted segmentation accuracy (IoU) by 63% and boundary precision (Surface Dice) by 6.2% by architecting a custom SE(2) Group Equivariant CNN with 2.5D spatial stacking.
Executed a rigorous, large-scale experimental pipeline across a 5-Fold Cross Validation setup, benchmarking 12 novel ablation architectures against 6 industry baselines (including nnU-Net).

title: ColonoMind: Hierarchical AI for Ulcerative Colitis Severity Grading
description: An advanced endoscopic image classification platform engineered to automatically grade Ulcerative Colitis severity (Mayo Endoscopic Score) from colonoscopy scans, specifically designed to overcome extreme clinical data imbalances.
feature:
Engineered a custom Mod-SE V2 architecture integrating Convolutional Block Attention Modules (CBAM) and Residual connections to pinpoint micro-ulcers.
Designed a Two-Stage Hierarchical pipeline (Detector & Grader) to mathematically isolate severe class imbalance, achieving >80% accuracy.

title: Sinus CT AI Segmentation & Foundation Model Benchmarking
description: An end-to-end medical AI training and evaluation pipeline for automated sinus structure segmentation, benchmarking standard CNN frameworks against modern prompt-based foundation models (SAM-Med3D).
feature:
Architected an automated multi-stage dataset preparation pipeline for both nnU-Net and SAM-Med3D native compatibility.
Engineered a robust standalone evaluation script to calculate complex spatial metrics (Dice, IoU, HD95, ASD) from 3D NIfTI predictions.

title: ColonoMind: Hybrid AI Diagnostic Agent for Ulcerative Colitis
description: An interactive clinical decision support platform that evaluates colonoscopy images using a hybrid ensemble of deep learning foundation models and handcrafted texture analysis to predict Mayo Endoscopic Scores (MES).
feature:
Architected a Streamlit clinical dashboard with real-time inference and dynamic visual analytics.
Engineered a hybrid feature extraction pipeline combining Deep Learning CNN/ViT embeddings with PyWavelets and GLCM texture features.

title: ColonoSense: Autonomous Clinical RAG Agent
description: An autonomous AI medical decision-support platform that utilizes Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to safely analyze Ulcerative Colitis patient data against global clinical guidelines.
feature:
Architected an autonomous Medical Decision-Support Agent using Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Langchain.
Engineered a deterministic 'Structured Patient Anchor' extraction pipeline to completely eliminate LLM hallucination on sensitive medical data.

title: LDCT-LUNA: Multi-Task AI Lung Nodule Diagnostician
description: An AI-powered diagnostic platform that leverages a multi-task SE(2) equivariant architecture and Explainable AI (Grad-CAM) to simultaneously segment and classify lung nodules from Low Dose CT (LDCT) scans.
feature:
Engineered a multi-task Mod-Seg-SE(2) CNN architecture for simultaneous lung nodule classification and segmentation.
Implemented an Explainable AI (XAI) pipeline using Grad-CAM to dynamically highlight model decision regions over segmented areas.

title: ColonoMind - AI Clinical Decision Support
description: An AI-powered clinical decision support mobile application designed to assist healthcare professionals in analyzing colonoscopy imagery, featuring LLM-based generative reporting and FHIR integration.
feature:
Architected a strict Clinical RAG pipeline ('ColonoTalk') for automated generative reporting.
Integrated a complete FHIR R4 Bundle export to ensure interoperability with hospital EHR systems.
